title: Ephesians Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Ephesians 6: children and parents, servants and masters, and the whole armor of God.

questions.text: Why does verse 1 tell children to obey their parents in the Lord?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says "Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right."

questions.text: What promise is attached to the commandment "Honor your father and mother"?
questions.explanation: Verses 2 and 3 call it the first commandment with a promise: "that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth".

answers.text: That it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth
That your children will honor you in turn
That your house will never be shaken on the earth
That you will see the Kingdom of God with your own eyes

questions.text: What are fathers told to do instead of provoking their children to wrath?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 tells fathers not to provoke their children to wrath, but to nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

answers.text: Leave their teaching to the elders of the assembly
Give them an inheritance early, while they are young
Send them to serve in another house
Nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord

questions.text: What does verse 8 say each one will receive for whatever good thing he does?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

answers.text: Praise from his own master, whether he is bound or free
The same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free
A place among the teachers of the assembly
Freedom from his bonds in the evil day

questions.text: What are masters told to give up, in verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 tells masters to do the same things to their servants and to give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and theirs is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

questions.text: According to verse 12, what is our wrestling not against?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, the powers, the world's rulers of the darkness of this age, and the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

questions.text: What does verse 14 say is buckled around the waist?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says to stand, having the utility belt of truth buckled around the waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness.

questions.text: With what will they be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says that above all they are to take up the shield of faith, with which they will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

answers.text: The preparation of the Good News of peace

questions.text: What does verse 17 call the sword of the Spirit?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says to take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

answers.text: The mystery of the Good News
The promise given to the fathers

questions.text: Who will make known to them how the writer is doing?
questions.explanation: Verses 21 and 22 say that Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to them all things, and that he was sent to comfort their hearts.
